verdict.rationale: Stripe Terminal's own docs cover in-person payments on compatible readers and contactless acceptance via Tap to Pay on iPhone and Android, so the core in-person contactless part of the story is delivered. Nothing in the pack explicitly mentions chip (EMV) insertion or Apple Pay / Google Pay wallet acceptance, so only about half the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: explicit chip/EMV card acceptance, explicit Apple Pay/Google Pay mobile-wallet support, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a merchant-ops user, I can accept chip, contactless, and mobile-wallet (Apple Pay / Google Pay) payments in person

citations.quote: Accept contactless payments using a compatible iPhone or Android device with the Stripe Terminal SDK.
Use Tap to Pay on iPhone to accept in-person contactless payments with a compatible iPhone.
Accept in-person payments on a compatible reader using Stripe's no-code solution.
you can accept in-person payments and manage them alongside your online payments in Stripe
